findings.title: Nurture met by a cut in return
findings.claim: The personal Rabb relation in the focus, heard with the step-by-step nurture carried by رَبِّهِۦ and the cutting and failure-to-recognize-good carried by كَنُودٌ, makes ingratitude legible as a cut in the return owed within a sustaining relation.
findings.mechanism: The focus Rabb carrier supplies development toward completion, while the kanud carrier supplies ending thanks and failing to recognize received good. 46:15 supplies maturation joined to gratitude and 16:83 supplies recognition followed by denial, changing the short diagnosis from an isolated trait into a broken response within care.
findings.reader_payoff: The possessive Rabb relation becomes semantically necessary: the reproach describes the direction of a continuing relationship, not merely an inner mood.
findings.containment: The primary reading remains İnsan gerçekten Rabbine karşı nankördür. This does not make every root use developmental or claim that the wider verses settle one exclusive interpretation.

epistemic.reason: The cross-run support and focus branches are trusted; wider target texts lack target morphology, so the relational synthesis remains qualified.

findings.containment: The nearness facet is bounded to this care contact; it does not turn every use of ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ into emotional nearness or identify the human with a domesticated creature.

epistemic.reason: The publication is trusted and the focus branches are supplied, but the global synthesis remains a qualified reading of wider care and gratitude contacts.

findings.title: Care received without yield
findings.claim: When رَبِّهِۦ carries step-by-step cultivation and كَنُودٌ carries land on which nothing grows, the focus can depict a human who receives care and blessing yet returns no gratitude-yield.
findings.mechanism: The Rabb process branch contacts 7:10's earth-establishment, livelihood, and little-gratitude scene, while the kanud land branch contacts the same provision field. The land-and-livelihood trigger makes the absent response visible as absent yield.
findings.reader_payoff: The charge becomes a failure of response under provision: care produces no answering fruit in the image.
findings.containment: The human is analogically rendered as non-yielding ground; the focus does not identify a person literally with soil or claim physical crop failure.

epistemic.reason: The publication is trusted but weak and presents the soil relation as analogy; the exact 7:10 target supplies a relevant wider provision trigger without target morphology.

findings.title: The bond remains, its direction changes
findings.claim: The possessive Rabb relation remains present while كَنُودٌ carries cutting and failure to answer received good; wider scenes of hoarding, rival attachment, and Rabb-directed desire make ingratitude legible as redirected attachment toward what is possessed.
findings.mechanism: The Rabb ownership carrier meets 94:8's exclusive desire toward the Rabb, while kanud meets 17:100's holding back of mercy from fear of spending and 39:8's forgetting after favor and setting up rivals. These contacts change the reading from inability to attach into attachment whose object has been redirected.
findings.reader_payoff: The human still binds itself, but the bond to the giver is cut while possession and received good become the tightened focus.
findings.containment: The focus does not grammatically mean wealth, hoarding, or rival worship; those wider scenes activate a contained directional analogy and the primary meaning remains recoverable.

epistemic.reason: The cross-run support is trusted and strong, while wider target texts lack target morphology; the wealth-direction relation is stated as qualified resonance.

findings.title: Collected water beside barren ground
findings.claim: The Rabb carrier can meet the image of layered and collected water while the kanud carrier supplies ground on which nothing grows; against the dry opening field and the wider water-gift contact, the focus becomes land receiving provision yet yielding nothing.
findings.mechanism: The reader walk connects Rabb's cloud and collected-water branches to the focus barren-land branch, while 100:1-5 supplies the dry opening field and 56:70 supplies fresh water as a gift linked to gratitude. The contacts change the diagnosis without making the human literally soil.
findings.reader_payoff: Absent gratitude becomes absent yield in a working provision image.
findings.containment: The image is analogical; root_001119/B001 and unresolved ن ق ع/B002 are excluded from the activated core.

epistemic.reason: The reader walk is legacy-unbound and contains an unresolved branch citation; retained focus branches have carriers and an exact wider water-gift target.

findings.title: Later return tightens the short diagnosis
findings.claim: The later return to Rabb and the later inward-disclosure movement make the focus judgment operate together as a broken relation with its nurturer and as a condition whose source will be opened from within; later context tightens both readings without selecting between them.
findings.mechanism: 100:11 returns to Rabb and 100:10 supplies the inward-disclosure turn reported in the retrospective walk. These triggers return through focus Rabb and kanud carriers, changing how the earlier one-line diagnosis is held while leaving both readings live.
findings.reader_payoff: A fixed moral label can later be reread as both relationship cut and interior condition without losing its plain force.
findings.containment: This is a retrospective reader effect, not a new grammatical claim inside 100:6; it does not determine the witness in 100:7.

epistemic.reason: The retrospective walk is legacy-unbound and supplies no structured branch trace; focus branch activations are retained as qualified contextual relations.

findings.title: Favor as seed, gratitude as yield
findings.claim: With رَبِّهِۦ carrying cultivation and completion and كَنُودٌ carrying ground that yields no growth, the later gift-and-seed context lets favor function analogically as something planted whose fitting return is produce.
findings.mechanism: The supplied 100:8 context provides seed-grain and gift imagery, while 56:70 supplies fresh water as a gift linked to gratitude. These triggers return through Rabb and kanud carriers, changing the barren-land picture into a nurture, planting, receiving-ground, and absent-yield mechanism.
findings.reader_payoff: The relation appears as a failed cycle of giving and return: favor arrives as provision while gratitude would be answering growth.
findings.containment: Planting, seed, and yield remain analogical; the unresolved context branch citations are not promoted to registered branches.

epistemic.reason: The reader walk is legacy-unbound and explicitly marks the direction from favor to gratitude as inference; focus branches and the exact water-gift target support a bounded analogy.

findings.reader_payoff: The inward turn is preserved while its lexical boundary stays visible.
findings.containment: root_001195/B002 is excluded for lack of a supplied occurrence; the finding does not identify the 100:7 witness or claim literal bodily storage.

epistemic.reason: The reader-walk support is legacy-unbound and its nominated hiddenness branch lacks an occurrence; the visible-carrier relation has supplied focus and inward-disclosure evidence.

friction_notes: All 28 supplied candidates were reviewed exactly once; no candidate-specific semantic obligations were present, so all semantic obligation arrays are empty.

Focus word alignment is complete, but selected_context_units is empty. Same-surah references used by reader walks are retained as explicitly named retrospective/context nominations rather than hydrated context morphology.

The 137 authored and 136 reciprocal connection records supply exact target Arabic but no target morphology. Connection labels and notes were treated as discovery nominations; broad, redundant, and no-value rows were not rendered separately.

The HFT source has zero cited anchors. HFT records without an exact carrier, trigger, attributed role, and focus return were rejected or represented only where an independently anchored candidate carried the same bounded claim.

The nominated root_001119/B001, root_000259/B009, and root_001195/B002 branches have no supplied carrier occurrences and were explicitly excluded wherever attached. The unresolved ن ق ع/B002 and حبب/B002 citations remain limitations and were not promoted to registered branches.

No additional uncandidate branch activation passed the form-and-trigger test: remaining focus branches are restricted to incompatible constructions, available without changed global understanding, or lacking an independent global carrier/trigger pair.
